value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A fever with a rash that does not fade when pressed can be serious, and waiting is risky. Tell staff about the fever and rash as soon as you arrive.
value.triage: Call 911 now if you cannot get to the ER right away, or if your child is drowsy, floppy, hard to wake, breathing fast, or the rash is spreading. Do not call 811 and wait - 811 is for nurse advice, and this needs the ER now.
